name: @kanzo-tech/ai
description: Kanzo AI surfaces — the transcript, the composer, a model's reasoning and the calls it makes, plus the field affordances that stream into a value. Sibling of @kanzo-tech/ui, not part of it: a Message has a role and one of the roles is `assistant`, which is domain knowledge the generic vocabulary does not carry.
//peers: Everything on the root barrel draws with @kanzo-tech/ui's parts and Ark's machines, so both are required peers rather than dependencies — two copies of Ark would mean two portals and two focus traps. streamdown is the one OPTIONAL peer, and it is why ./markdown exists: it measures 495 kB minified and 128 kB brotli on its own, against a 20 kB budget for the whole root barrel, so a host that renders plain text must not pay for a markdown parser. Same door as @kanzo-tech/ui/editor and @kanzo-tech/graph/duckdb.
//size-limit: First measurement taken at the split, so this budget is a change detector from day one rather than a number inherited from somewhere. The four AI-assist modules that moved here cost @kanzo-tech/ui's root barrel about 4 kB when they arrived (38 -> 42 kB, recorded in that package's own note); the barrel is rebaselined down by the same move.
